data.description: Savings account with bonus interest if you meet the eligibility criteria.
data.name: ANZ Progress Saver

depositRates.additionalInfo: Bonus interest is subject to eligibility. ANZ Progress Saver pays bonus interest (in addition to the current variable base interest) in respect of a particular month if the set minimum deposit (currently $10) and no withdrawals, fees or charges are processed to the account on or before the last business day of that calendar month, and after the last business day of the previous calendar month. Bonus and base rates are variable and subject to change.
depositRates.additionalValue: When you make a single deposit of $10 or more in a month and no withdrawals

eligibility.additionalInfo: You must be 12 years of age or older to apply

eligibility.additionalValue: You must be an Australian resident with an Australian residential and mailing address.

features.additionalInfo: Access using ANZ Internet Banking or ANZ App

Create a PayID® on your eligible account (PDF) using your mobile phone, email or ABN/ACN (if eligible). With PayID, it's easier to receive payments or set up a PayTo agreement by sharing your PayID instead of your BSB and account number.
Unlimited ANZ Internet banking transactions plus one ANZ transaction per month

You can qualify for bonus interest when you make at least a single deposit of $10 or more in a month and if no withdrawals, transfers, fees or charges are processed to the account in that month. Bonus interest is subject to eligibility. Refer to ANZ Saving & Transaction Products T&Cs for further details including what’s included in your balance, how interest is calculated and how we work out if you earn and qualify for bonus interest. Interest rates are variable and subject to change.

Set and track your savings goal
Whether you're saving for something big or small, you can set a goal in the ANZ APP to help you save, and see how you're tracking. Set a savings goal today.
